The Vivitar ViviCam 2000 is a digital camera, dating to 1997 (per copyright date in manual).[https://www.manualslib.com/manual/336619/Vivitar-Vivicam-2000.html Page one of Manual] at manualslib 

It has two resolution modes, standard resolution 320x240 and "high" resolution 640x480, has a fixed-focus lens, a self-timer, and needed four AA alkaline batteries to operate.[https://web.archive.org/web/
